purpose: Keep status:blocked in step with '- Blocked by: #N' lines in issue bodies: add it while any referenced blocker is open, remove it when none are.

jobs.summary: github-script paginates all open issues, parses the first '- Blocked by:' line, checks each blocker's state via issues.get, and adds or removes status:blocked.

failure_points.issue: Every issue opened/edited/reopened event rescans all open issues instead of the one that changed, plus one issues.get per blocker, so the API cost grows with the backlog.
No concurrency group, so bursts of edits run overlapping full scans.
Regex has no g flag and requires a '- Blocked by:' list item; only the first such line is read.
Removes status:blocked from any issue without a 'Blocked by' line, so manually applied blocks (for example external blockers) are cleared.
Adds status:blocked without removing the existing status:* label; one-hot resolution is left to the agent's status-enforcer.
Only same-repository #N references are parsed; owner/repo#N blockers are ignored.

overlaps_with: labeling-unified.yml (same issues opened/edited/reopened events; status one-hot enforcement in status-enforcer.js)
